cim: How to request and enable Daybreak Blue
cim_eredeti: How to request and enable Daybreak Blue
szoveg_eredeti: Learn how to request access to Daybreak Blue and enable it for your workspace and API organization. This walkthrough covers business verification, workspace permissions, role-based access controls, and confirming access in Codex. You’ll also see how to set up a project and API key for automation.
